product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides multichannel business messaging across SMS, MMS, WhatsApp and other channels for sales, marketing and customer-service teams.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 208 employees, while the company's careers page reports 200+ team members in India; estimates vary across sources.

hq_location.notes: The contact page labels Henderson as the Global/USA headquarters and Pune as the EMEA/APAC development center.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index shows product, marketing and messaging-advice posts, not two qualifying engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes Salesforce and Zoho guides, administrator documentation and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the 11 listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The documentation describes integrating customer-supplied OpenAI models using an API key and optional Assistant ID; it does not establish an exclusive or default model.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page lists ISO 27001:2013 as a security certification and HIPAA and GDPR under compliance; these are public claims, not independent verification.

last_funding.notes: The company profile labels it bootstrapped, and the main funding history records no rounds. Some database FAQ text is inconsistent; no verifiable institutional investment round was identified.

raised_18mo.notes: The bootstrapped company profile and main funding history show no recorded investment round in the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Team Lead – Account Executive opening in Pune has an application option.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 29, 2026 release introduced RingCentral CTI integration for unified calling, messaging and CRM activity management.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying change could be verified from a complete, dated leadership roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Listed for customer relationship management, marketing data management and marketing automation, respectively.
